show.description: Raj, the iconic but anonymous DJ King, decides to find a wife who loves him for himself not his fame. He meets Simran, a struggling music label CEO. After a whirlwind contract marriage to save her from the sleazy Karan Oberoi, Raj must endure the relentless humiliation and "poor" treatment from her elitist family. He uses his massive wealth and influence to protect Simran’s business, the ultimate reveal looms: the "lowly" DJ they despise is actually the superstar they are desperate to sign.
